'''Bluuto Karlabasy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] living on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] he visited a [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] village on a remote island.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bluuto Karlabasy appears at a speeder quick travel point in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
